name: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

deadline.intake: 2027 entry; priority round deadline (rolling from 2026-11-26; closes 2027-06-30)

tuition.note: Annual non-local UG, 2026-27 cohort; page shows '$' only, HKD not explicitly stated

requirement.text: Graduate from high school with an international qualification (IB, A-levels, SAT/ACT/AP or national system), submit school reports from Grade 10, personal statement, referee, English proof (IELTS Academic 6.0 overall); HKD 600 application fee.
